Prefer a cold worker over a clever corpus when you stage the vector. Yield the small vector before the record reaches the ledger.

Buffer the local ledger before the worker reaches the index. A boring pipeline that cannot be observed is a hook you cannot wire.

A warm record that cannot be observed is a shard you cannot unwind. Keep the portable token small, then measure the corpus and record the cache.
